accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.metaDescription: How this site meets WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard support, screen readers, reduced motion, contrast, known limitations and how to report a problem.
accessibility.intro: I want everyone to be able to read this site and reach me, whatever device, input method or assistive technology they use.
accessibility.standardText: The target is the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA, with AAA contrast for body text where it is inexpensive.

measures.keyboard: Every control works with a keyboard, with a visible focus ring and a skip link to the main content.
measures.semantics: Pages use landmarks, one main heading, real lists and native controls, and are tested with automated checks on every change.
measures.motion: Animations follow your system’s reduced-motion setting, and the “Pause animations” button in the footer stops them on any device.
measures.contrast: Text and controls meet AA contrast on every surface, and high-contrast and forced-colors modes are supported.
measures.noScript: All reading and navigation work without JavaScript: language switch, project filters and pagination are plain links.

limitations.decorative: Decorative animations, such as the hero background, are hidden from assistive technology and have no text equivalent because they carry no information.
limitations.thirdParty: Linked external sites are outside my control and may not meet the same standard.

accessibility.feedbackText: If something gets in your way, tell me and I will fix it. The contact section has my email.
